### Imports
```{r, results="hide", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(car)
# library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(lattice)
library(ggplotify)
source("data_wrangling/create_analysis_df.R")
```


```{r}

df = analysis_df_factors |>
  filter(bmi < 45) |>  # filtering two outlier participants
  mutate( # not scaling comorbidities (0-11), medications (0-8) or precipitation hours
    across(
      c(age, bmi),
      ~ scale(.x)
      ),
    across(
      starts_with("daily_") & !contains("cloud_cover") & !contains("precipitation_hours"),
      ~ scale(.x)
      ),
    daily_cloud_cover_mean = daily_cloud_cover_mean / 20,
    daily_precipitation_hours = daily_precipitation_hours / 4
    ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    starts_with("avg_acc_") | starts_with("IG_") & !contains("rsq")
  )


```

### modelling


```{r}

metric = "avg_acc_AGSA"

model_df = df |>
  filter(name == metric) |>
  mutate(week_number_participant = factor(Participant:week_number_participant)) # nest week number within participant

```


```{r}

form = value ~ (1 | Participant) + (1 | week_number_participant) +
  (season_winter + season_spring) * country_code * daily_temperature_2m_max_oe +
  weekend_or_holiday +
  age +
  sex +
  bmi_factor +
  secondary_prevention_yn +
  comorbidities_n +
  medications_n +
  cardiomyopathy +
  myocardialinfarction +
  daily_precipitation_hours +
  daily_sunshine_duration_hours_oe +
  daily_wind_speed_10m_max +
  # daily_cloud_cover_mean +
  event_icd +
  event_level_before +
  event_level_after
  # FileMeasurementDeviceID +
  # FileMeasurementFrequency

model = lmer(formula = form, data = model_df)

saveRDS(model, paste0("analysis/models/model_", metric, ".rds"))

summary(model)
# vif(model)
# anova(model)
```



#### confidence intervals

```{r}
confidence_intervals = confint(model, oldNames = FALSE)
confidence_intervals
```

### prediction and simulation
#### season

```{r}

pred_df = expand_grid(
  Participant = NA,
  day_of_year = 1:365,
  country_code = c("DK", "NL"),
  daily_temperature_2m_max_oe = 0,
  weekend_or_holiday = "0",
  age = 0,
  sex = "Male",
  bmi_factor = "normal",
  secondary_prevention_yn = "Yes",
  comorbidities_n = 3,
  medications_n = 4,
  cardiomyopathy = "1",
  myocardialinfarction = "0",
  daily_precipitation_hours = 0.5,
  daily_sunshine_duration_hours_oe = 0,
  daily_wind_speed_10m_max = 0,
  event_icd = "0",
  event_level_before = "0",
  event_level_after = "0",
  week_number_participant = NA
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    season_winter = cos(2 * pi * day_of_year / 365.24),
    season_spring = sin(2 * pi * day_of_year / 365.24)
  )

predictions = predict(model, pred_df, re.form = NA, allow.new.levels = TRUE, se.fit = TRUE)
pred_df$predicted_value = predictions$fit
pred_df$hci = predictions$fit + 1.96 * predictions$se.fit
pred_df$lci = predictions$fit - 1.96 * predictions$se.fit
  
```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}

ylims = c(
  mean(pred_df$predicted_value) - 2.5 * mean(pred_df$hci - pred_df$lci),
  mean(pred_df$predicted_value) + 2.5 * mean(pred_df$hci - pred_df$lci)
)

fig1 = pred_df |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = day_of_year, ymin = lci, ymax = hci, fill = country_code), alpha = .3) +
  geom_line(aes(day_of_year, predicted_value, colour = country_code))  +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 365, by = 91)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = ylims) +
  labs(x = "Day of the year", y = metric, colour = "Country", fill = "Country", title = paste0(metric, " through the year")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey")
    )

fig1

ggsave(
  paste0("analysis/viz/fig1_", metric, ".png"),
  plot = fig1,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

```



#### temp max
```{r}

pred_df = expand_grid(
  Participant = NA,
  day_of_year = c(31, 122, 213, 304),
  country_code = c("DK", "NL"),
  daily_temperature_2m_max_oe = seq(-3, 3, by = 0.1),
  weekend_or_holiday = "0",
  age = 0,
  sex = "Male",
  bmi_factor = "normal",
  secondary_prevention_yn = "Yes",
  comorbidities_n = 3,
  medications_n = 4,
  cardiomyopathy = "1",
  myocardialinfarction = "0",
  daily_precipitation_hours = 0.5,
  daily_sunshine_duration_hours_oe = 0,
  daily_wind_speed_10m_max = 0,
  event_icd = "0",
  event_level_before = "0",
  event_level_after = "0",
  week_number_participant = NA
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    season_winter = cos(2 * pi * day_of_year / 365.24),
    season_spring = sin(2 * pi * day_of_year / 365.24)
  )

predictions = predict(model, pred_df, re.form = NA, allow.new.levels = TRUE, se.fit = TRUE)
pred_df$predicted_value = predictions$fit
pred_df$hci = predictions$fit + 1.96 * predictions$se.fit
pred_df$lci = predictions$fit - 1.96 * predictions$se.fit
  
```



